A '''wooden pickaxe''' is a [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]] of the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] tier, crafted from three planks and two sticks. Since stone tools do not exist in Matcha Flavoured, it is the only pickaxe before copper, and it is built to reach [[native copper]] and little else.

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
It breaks pickaxe blocks at speed {{Value|Wooden Pickaxe|miningspeed}} (vanilla: 2) and has {{Value|Wooden Pickaxe|durability}} durability.

It harvests stone, [[coal deposit]]s, [[native copper]] and [[quartz deposit]]s. It gets no drops from [[hematite]], [[native gold]], [[native silver]], diamond ore, [[sulfurous quartz deposit]]s, [[sulfur deposit]]s, [[natural lapis lazuli]], deepslate (including cobbled and polished deepslate), obsidian, crying obsidian or ender chests, all of which it breaks at speed 3.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/wood.json}}</ref> Deepslate and hematite therefore wait for a [[copper pickaxe]].

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Wooden Pickaxe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Wooden Pickaxe|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with planks. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
